T-001, T-003, T-006 and T-007 are medium with stated reasons. Advisory: T-012 and T-013 are largely test-authoring but gate a baseline/oracle write path, so the tier is justified in their rationale text.

Every high task (T-002, T-004, T-005, T-008, T-009, T-010, T-011, T-012, T-013) has a Done When item with RED/GREEN TDD evidence and an independent quality-gate verdict recording PASS. No task is Risk: critical.
Done When lists have at most 8 items (T-004 has 8). Each task title and goal names one coherent deliverable. No fragmented single-edit tasks. T-011 and T-013 were already split for single concern.

Functional tasks carry explicit negative or error-path cases: T-002 CI-set and approved-by-omitted refusals, T-004 malformed corpus, T-005 non-regression and mismatch emits no event, T-009 capability-only usage error, T-010 three hard-fail fixtures, T-012 refusal on structural mismatch, T-013 AC-040/041 negatives. No functional task is happy-path only.

Suites are described consistently with their scope. TEST-018 and TEST-019 are integration drives through the shared driver and fixture builder. Contract and manifest suites are unit-scope. T-003 and T-011 map to specific AC IDs.

Every high task has a Rollback: field (revert commits, with infra-spec.md#rollback references). T-011 additionally covers human-copy staging reversal. T-012 describes git revert of a refreshed corpus entry.

Shared files (tests/run-all.*, loop-consistency/loop-escalation suites, compatibility-event-trace fixtures, structural-fixture-corpus, test.yml) are ordered through Blockers or Global Constraints serialization. T-011 is the sole test.yml editor. T-005 and T-009 touch different files. No uncoordinated overlap found.

Blockers match functional or declared run-all serialization dependencies. The order-only blockers (T-004 on T-002/T-003, T-013 on T-003/T-004/T-010) are explicitly labelled as shared-array write serialization, which SCOPE-DISJOINT requires. Advisory: T-010's Depends On attributes ad hoc SKIP lines to T-003, although T-003's Done When has none; this is non-blocking.
